sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: MADE forward direct branch only; inverse loop is documented rather than falsely parallelized.

sourceFacts: Degree masks enforce strict autoregressive dependence through the output degree offset; masks are registered buffers.
MADE shares a masked trunk and chunks its 2D output into m then a; pre_exp_tanh is accepted but unused by this class.
Inverse builds coordinates one at a time with the same learned networks; the direct view is a DAG, not that inverse execution.
The returned logdet follows the exact source expression. It is not a third sequential layer applied to u.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
